hook.first_sentence: Ninety-three gigabytes, and that is the small one.

scenes.narration: Ninety-three gigabytes, and that is the small one.
GLM Flash went open weight, free to download. You want it on your machine tonight.
Its smallest file spends a single bit per weight. Your gaming card holds thirty-two gigabytes of memory.
The page says eighteen billion active parameters. Sounds runnable. But it's a mixture of experts, a whole staff behind a receptionist.
Each word wakes a few specialists. Memory keeps the whole building, because the receptionist picks fresh every word. All three hundred twenty billion parameters stay loaded.
This drop is for unified memory, where processor and graphics share a single pool. Unsloth's guide sizes it for one hundred twenty-eight gigabyte machines. The license opened. The memory didn't.
Before you download, read your total memory. If it's smaller than the file, close the tab.
